verdict.rationale: MailerSend publishes llms.txt files at both developers.mailersend.com and www.mailersend.com, and a live probe confirmed the developer one returns HTTP 200 with a structured documentation index. The content summarizes API capabilities (WhatsApp, scheduled messages, verification, templates) in agent-readable form, which delivers the story's core of pointing an agent at llms.txt. missing for 10: per-page markdown doc variants (the /.md probe returned 404), a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (all probed paths 404), and independent hands-on corroboration of agents consuming these docs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
